question: The ‘Infant Mortality Rate’ is defined as the number of deaths of infants aged less than one year per _________ live births in a given year.
solution:
The correct answer is**__ 1000__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** infant mortality rate is usually expressed as a rate per 1000 live births (LB).**
 
• It is the **second best indicato**r of the socio-economic development of a country.
 
• The best indicator of SE development: is the under 5 mortality rate (U5MR)
 
• Infant mortality rate (IMR)** is the number of infant deaths under one year of age per 1,000 live births in one year.**
 
• **It is given by the formula- **
 
• IMR= Number of deaths under one year of age divided by total live births in the year. ×1, 000
 
• It is an almost universally accepted indicator of health status.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• It’s a sensitive indicator of the availability, utilization, and effectiveness of health care, Particularly perinatal care.
 
• The most common causes of IMR in India-
 
 
• Low birth weight.
 
• Prematurity.
 
 
 
• The most common cause of IMR in the world- is pneumonia.
